### 2026-10-16 – # October 17 - Started work on my Model Train Track

**4.23h**

# October 17 - Started work on my Model Train Track

## Header
First I thought, what can I possibly model that is not too simple but that still does not take too much time.
So I choosed to make a Model Train Track that you can possibly expand with more track parts.

## Work start
I started by using a website called [Kleki](https://kleki.com). In it I drew the most basic work of the model train track. So what do you do with it, drive the train... or just push it arround.

## Train model
After I had gotten my idea in place I went into a 3D moddeling software called [Shapr3D](https://www.shapr3d.com/). In addition to working on the train model I also used a caliper to figure out a typicall scale for the train that the track parts later will be customized for.

# October 18 - Finished Train Model

## What has changed
Today I started by double checking some values on my model since earlier. After that I also looked at how some trains do for their turning so that I can get some hopefully working wheels.

![ModelTrain_11](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8iQdaOwcrYZr4ba8jsAlUZx1MLmtyDZ7/bda70fa46075b9bd523d194887f58960de6edb332f814579cb4d9b1a8e07faf7.png)

![ModelTrain_10](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8iQdaOwcrYZr4ba8jsAlUZx1MLmtyDZ7/5ca5101387990052dfa248b5438ab1832eee011909e70da5a99b36af7ca6ec69.png)

## New stuff learnt!
I have learned a new tool in Shapr3D. Apparently you can select a body and say that you want to use another object as a cutting tool thereby cutting it out of your body. I have used this tool at a different points but for other stuff.

## Train model
I have added the wheels to the train. By following a few pictures about trains I managed to see that when you want it to stay on the track, you would make the outer part of the wheel a bit slanted inwards toward the inner part of the train that is a bit wider giving you some use of the center of mass pulling the wheel towards the midpoint of track.
In addition you also want to make the most inner part of the wheel wider then the slanted part, otherwise the train wheels would push the other side up and over the edge.

![ModelTrain_9](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8iQdaOwcrYZr4ba8jsAlUZx1MLmtyDZ7/32fbbd7ab814b295af2b2605620e63fe2ca7f80b8a92222cc044df7b5773397a.png)

### - Finished work
To create the straight piece aswell as the curve I had to import the train aswell as the straight piece into the curve. It took me some minutes figuring out where the import button itself was. After I found it I were able to import the train, getting the straight piece to look nice aswell as the locking system. After the straight piece were done I imported it into the curve giving me the profile (sweep) needed to make the curve look nice.
